units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Ijs and Katya|You are on <origin>, home to the Free Worlds Conservatory where Ijs is on faculty as a professor. Would you like to visit him and see how he is doing?|22|0
units.english: You are on <origin>, home to the Free Worlds Conservatory where Ijs is on faculty as a professor. Would you like to visit him and see how he is doing?
units.italian: Sei su <origin>, sede del Conservatorio delle Free Worlds, dove Ijs insegna come professore. Vuoi andare a trovarlo per vedere come sta?

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Ijs and Katya|	(Yes.)|24|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Ijs and Katya|	(Not right now.)|25|0
units.english: (Not right now.)
units.italian: (Non adesso.)

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Ijs and Katya|	While looking Ijs up in the campus directory, you notice something else: Katya is listed in the directory too, as "Visiting Professor of Civics and Economics." You give Ijs a call and ask if he and Katya would like to meet up with you for dinner, and they readily agree.|27|0
units.english: While looking Ijs up in the campus directory, you notice something else: Katya is listed in the directory too, as "Visiting Professor of Civics and Economics." You give Ijs a call and ask if he and Katya would like to meet up with you for dinner, and they readily agree.
units.italian: Mentre cerchi Ijs nell'elenco del corpo docente, noti un'altra cosa: anche Katya è nell'elenco, come "professoressa a contratto di educazione civica ed economia". Chiami Ijs e gli chiedi se lui e Katya vorrebbero incontrarti per cena, e accettano volentieri.

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Ijs and Katya|	When you join them at the restaurant, Katya says, "It's really great to see you again, <first>."|28|0
units.english: When you join them at the restaurant, Katya says, "It's really great to see you again, <first>."
units.italian: Quando li raggiungi al ristorante, Katya dice: "È davvero bello rivederti, <first>."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Ijs and Katya|	"Not to mention," says Ijs, "it's great to have an excuse to eat somewhere other than the student center for once. How has life been treating you, <first>?"|29|0
units.english: "Not to mention," says Ijs, "it's great to have an excuse to eat somewhere other than the student center for once. How has life been treating you, <first>?"
units.italian: "Per non parlare," dice Ijs, "del piacere di avere una scusa per mangiare da qualche parte che non sia il centro studentesco, per una volta. Come ti sta trattando la vita, <first>?"

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Ijs and Katya|	"I miss the excitement of the work we did together, but other than that life is great."|31|0
units.english: "I miss the excitement of the work we did together, but other than that life is great."
units.italian: "Mi manca l'emozione del lavoro che facevamo insieme, ma a parte questo la vita è splendida."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Ijs and Katya|	"It's kind of hard to adjust to civilian life."|33|0
units.english: "It's kind of hard to adjust to civilian life."
units.italian: "È un po' difficile abituarsi alla vita civile."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Ijs and Katya|	"I want to explore the rest of the galaxy, but apparently that part of the game hasn't been fully implemented yet."|35|0
units.english: "I want to explore the rest of the galaxy, but apparently that part of the game hasn't been fully implemented yet."
units.italian: "Voglio esplorare il resto della galassia, ma a quanto pare quella parte del gioco non è ancora stata implementata del tutto."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Ijs and Katya|	"I understand that feeling," says Katya. "But, just remind yourself, this is what we fought for. For peace. For a world where no one has to fear for their lives."|39|0
units.english: "I understand that feeling," says Katya. "But, just remind yourself, this is what we fought for. For peace. For a world where no one has to fear for their lives."
units.italian: "Capisco quella sensazione," dice Katya. "Ma ricordati: è per questo che abbiamo combattuto. Per la pace. Per un mondo in cui nessuno debba temere per la propria vita."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Ijs and Katya|	"Tell me about it," laughs Katya. "I can hardly believe I'm now a professor. Or at least, acting as one. But after so much fighting, and so much time alone and imprisoned, for me it feels good to finally be able to relax, to let go of the idea that the galaxy will fall apart without me."|43|0
units.english: "Tell me about it," laughs Katya. "I can hardly believe I'm now a professor. Or at least, acting as one. But after so much fighting, and so much time alone and imprisoned, for me it feels good to finally be able to relax, to let go of the idea that the galaxy will fall apart without me."
units.italian: "Dimmi tu," ride Katya. "Fatico a credere di essere ormai una professoressa. O almeno, di fare quel mestiere. Ma dopo tanti combattimenti, e tanto tempo da sola e in prigione, per me è bello potermi finalmente rilassare, lasciar andare l'idea che la galassia crollerebbe senza di me."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Ijs and Katya|	"Whoops," says Ijs, "now you've done it, there goes the fourth wall."|47|0
units.english: "Whoops," says Ijs, "now you've done it, there goes the fourth wall."
units.italian: "Ops," dice Ijs, "ora l'hai fatto, è caduta la quarta parete."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Ijs and Katya|	Katya laughs. "Well, there's already lots beyond human space to see, and I'm sure you can find more things to do out there as well as closer to home. If you're so eager to explore more of the galaxy, <first>, or to discover what new adventures it has to offer, maybe you should volunteer to help out with creating the stories to populate it. This is an open source game after all, and it relies on people like you to bring it to life."|48|0
units.english: Katya laughs. "Well, there's already lots beyond human space to see, and I'm sure you can find more things to do out there as well as closer to home. If you're so eager to explore more of the galaxy, <first>, or to discover what new adventures it has to offer, maybe you should volunteer to help out with creating the stories to populate it. This is an open source game after all, and it relies on people like you to bring it to life."
units.italian: Katya ride. "Beh, oltre lo spazio umano c'è già tanto da vedere, e sono sicura che troverai altre cose da fare anche più vicino a casa. Se hai così tanta voglia di esplorare la galassia, <first>, o di scoprire quali nuove avventure ha da offrire, magari dovresti offrirti di aiutare a creare le storie che la popolano. Dopotutto questo è un gioco open source, e si basa su gente come te per prendere vita."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Ijs and Katya|	Your dinner arrives, and you spend a pleasant evening eating together and reminiscing about old times. Back in the days of the civil war, neither Katya nor Ijs were people who smiled or laughed easily. Now, however, they have an entirely different air about them, peaceful and contented. It's heartening to see that they, at least, have found a happy ending together after all the chaos you lived through.|52|0
units.english: Your dinner arrives, and you spend a pleasant evening eating together and reminiscing about old times. Back in the days of the civil war, neither Katya nor Ijs were people who smiled or laughed easily. Now, however, they have an entirely different air about them, peaceful and contented. It's heartening to see that they, at least, have found a happy ending together after all the chaos you lived through.
units.italian: Arriva la cena, e passate una serata piacevole mangiando insieme e ricordando i vecchi tempi. Ai tempi della guerra civile né Katya né Ijs erano persone che sorridevano o ridevano facilmente. Ora hanno un'aria del tutto diversa, serena e soddisfatta. È confortante vedere che loro, almeno, hanno trovato un lieto fine insieme dopo tutto il caos che avete vissuto.

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Ijs and Katya|	Suddenly you realize that around you, the restaurant workers are sweeping the floors and putting chairs up on tables: it's closing time, and you are the last ones there. "Well <first>," says Ijs, "it was good of you to stop by, and I wish you the best in your journeys among the stars. Give our regards to the others if you see them." You wish them well, and return to your ship.|53|0
units.english: Suddenly you realize that around you, the restaurant workers are sweeping the floors and putting chairs up on tables: it's closing time, and you are the last ones there. "Well <first>," says Ijs, "it was good of you to stop by, and I wish you the best in your journeys among the stars. Give our regards to the others if you see them." You wish them well, and return to your ship.
units.italian: All'improvviso ti rendi conto che intorno a voi i camerieri stanno spazzando i pavimenti e mettendo le sedie sui tavoli: è ora di chiudere, e siete gli ultimi rimasti. "Beh, <first>," dice Ijs, "è stato bello che tu sia passato, e ti auguro il meglio nei tuoi viaggi fra le stelle. Salutaci gli altri se li vedi." Auguri loro ogni bene e torni alla tua nave.

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Alondo|As you're coming in for a landing on Bourne, you receive a message from Alondo. "<first>!" he says. "I just heard that you were in system. Want to meet up for a drink and talk about old times?"|69|0
units.english: As you're coming in for a landing on Bourne, you receive a message from Alondo. "<first>!" he says. "I just heard that you were in system. Want to meet up for a drink and talk about old times?"
units.italian: Mentre ti avvicini per atterrare su Bourne, ricevi un messaggio da Alondo. "<first>!" dice. "Ho appena saputo che eri nel sistema. Ti va di vederci per un drink e parlare dei vecchi tempi?"

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Alondo|	"Sure, I'd be glad to."|71|0
units.english: "Sure, I'd be glad to."
units.italian: "Certo, con piacere."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Alondo|	"Sorry, I'm busy right now."|72|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm busy right now."
units.italian: "Scusa, sono impegnato adesso."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Alondo|	You meet up with Alondo at a local pub. He tells you that his life has continued to be quite full since the war ended and the Council was dissolved: he's been placed in charge of the Free Worlds diplomatic corps, whose main job appears to be to make sure all the individual planets feel like their concerns are being listened to. "It means lots of travel," he says, "and lots of fine meals with important people. And they're always interested to hear my stories from the war times."|74|0
units.english: You meet up with Alondo at a local pub. He tells you that his life has continued to be quite full since the war ended and the Council was dissolved: he's been placed in charge of the Free Worlds diplomatic corps, whose main job appears to be to make sure all the individual planets feel like their concerns are being listened to. "It means lots of travel," he says, "and lots of fine meals with important people. And they're always interested to hear my stories from the war times."
units.italian: Incontri Alondo in un pub del posto. Ti racconta che la sua vita è continuata piuttosto piena da quando la guerra è finita e il Consiglio è stato sciolto: è stato messo a capo del corpo diplomatico delle Free Worlds, il cui compito principale sembra essere assicurarsi che tutti i singoli pianeti sentano che le loro preoccupazioni vengono ascoltate. "Significa viaggiare molto," dice, "e molti pranzi eleganti con persone importanti. E sono sempre interessati a sentire le mie storie del tempo di guerra."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Alondo|	You tell Alondo a bit about what you've been doing since the war ended. "Of course," he says, "you're traveling the galaxy. I knew from the start you weren't the kind who would quickly put down roots on a single planet."|75|0
units.english: You tell Alondo a bit about what you've been doing since the war ended. "Of course," he says, "you're traveling the galaxy. I knew from the start you weren't the kind who would quickly put down roots on a single planet."
units.italian: Racconti ad Alondo un po' di quello che hai fatto da quando la guerra è finita. "Certo," dice, "tu viaggi per la galassia. L'avevo capito fin dall'inizio che non eri il tipo da mettere radici in fretta su un solo pianeta."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Alondo|	Alondo goes on to describe some of the inner workings of the Free Worlds Senate, and the mutual defense arrangement that forms the backbone of the government. "For a while there," he says, "it felt like there was so much bureaucracy that we couldn't get anything done, but now it's finally starting to function in the way all of us imagined. Quite an honor to have had a hand in the birth of a new government."|76|0
units.english: Alondo goes on to describe some of the inner workings of the Free Worlds Senate, and the mutual defense arrangement that forms the backbone of the government. "For a while there," he says, "it felt like there was so much bureaucracy that we couldn't get anything done, but now it's finally starting to function in the way all of us imagined. Quite an honor to have had a hand in the birth of a new government."
units.italian: Alondo prosegue descrivendo alcuni dei meccanismi interni del Senato delle Free Worlds, e l'accordo di difesa reciproca che costituisce la spina dorsale del governo. "Per un po'," dice, "sembrava che ci fosse così tanta burocrazia che non riuscivamo a combinare niente, ma ora finalmente comincia a funzionare come l'avevamo immaginato tutti. Un bell'onore aver avuto parte nella nascita di un nuovo governo."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Alondo|	"Spoken like a true bureaucrat."|78|0
units.english: "Spoken like a true bureaucrat."
units.italian: "Parole da vero burocrate."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Alondo|	"I really do hope the Free Worlds can live up to our original vision of justice and equality."|80|0
units.english: "I really do hope the Free Worlds can live up to our original vision of justice and equality."
units.italian: "Spero davvero che le Free Worlds riescano a essere all'altezza della nostra idea originale di giustizia e uguaglianza."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Alondo|	"Fair enough," he says, "but I really do believe we've created a government here that is less prone to the inequalities that they're still struggling with in the Republic."|84|0
units.english: "Fair enough," he says, "but I really do believe we've created a government here that is less prone to the inequalities that they're still struggling with in the Republic."
units.italian: "Giusto," dice, "ma credo davvero che qui abbiamo creato un governo meno incline alle disuguaglianze con cui la Repubblica sta ancora lottando."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Alondo|	"Me too," he says. "We've got a good start, but then again, so did the Republic, back in the day."|88|0
units.english: "Me too," he says. "We've got a good start, but then again, so did the Republic, back in the day."
units.italian: "Anch'io," dice. "Siamo partiti bene, ma del resto anche la Repubblica, a suo tempo."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Alondo|	He is quiet for a moment, and then says, "I guess that's why I'm still here in the thick of things, instead of just settling down somewhere and leaving public life behind. I don't believe society or government just naturally becomes good or stays good without effort. So I'm here to speak up when we start to stray from our original vision."|92|0
units.english: He is quiet for a moment, and then says, "I guess that's why I'm still here in the thick of things, instead of just settling down somewhere and leaving public life behind. I don't believe society or government just naturally becomes good or stays good without effort. So I'm here to speak up when we start to stray from our original vision."
units.italian: Resta in silenzio un momento, poi dice: "Immagino che sia per questo che sono ancora qui nel mezzo delle cose, invece di sistemarmi da qualche parte e lasciarmi alle spalle la vita pubblica. Non credo che la società o il governo diventino buoni per natura, né che restino buoni senza sforzo. Quindi sono qui per parlare quando cominciamo ad allontanarci dalla nostra idea originale."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Alondo|	You sit and talk with each other for quite a while longer, reminiscing about old times. Then, you wish him well in his work, and he tells you to stop by and say hello any time you're in the area. You head back to your ship.|93|0
units.english: You sit and talk with each other for quite a while longer, reminiscing about old times. Then, you wish him well in his work, and he tells you to stop by and say hello any time you're in the area. You head back to your ship.
units.italian: Restate seduti a parlare ancora parecchio, ricordando i vecchi tempi. Poi gli auguri buon lavoro, e lui ti dice di passare a salutarlo ogni volta che sei da quelle parti. Torni alla tua nave.

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Freya|When you land on <origin>, you head into the city to explore a bit and to find out if the Navy and the others who have come here after them have had any luck in unlocking the secrets of this place. Already, it appears that some of the empty apartments have become actual living quarters for people, and there are even a handful of shops opening up on the main street.|106|0
units.english: When you land on <origin>, you head into the city to explore a bit and to find out if the Navy and the others who have come here after them have had any luck in unlocking the secrets of this place. Already, it appears that some of the empty apartments have become actual living quarters for people, and there are even a handful of shops opening up on the main street.
units.italian: Quando atterri su <origin>, ti addentri in città per esplorare un po' e scoprire se la Marina e gli altri arrivati dopo di loro hanno avuto fortuna nello svelare i segreti di questo luogo. Già si vede che alcuni degli appartamenti vuoti sono diventati vere abitazioni per la gente, e ci sono persino un paio di negozi che aprono sulla strada principale.

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Freya|	In one of those shops, you run into Freya. "<first>!" she says. "It's good to see you again. I hear that Parliament named you an official war hero or something. Much better than being a wanted fugitive, huh?"|107|0
units.english: In one of those shops, you run into Freya. "<first>!" she says. "It's good to see you again. I hear that Parliament named you an official war hero or something. Much better than being a wanted fugitive, huh?"
units.italian: In uno di quei negozi ti imbatti in Freya. "<first>!" dice. "Che bello rivederti. Ho sentito che il Parlamento ti ha nominato eroe di guerra ufficiale o qualcosa del genere. Molto meglio che essere un fuggitivo ricercato, eh?"

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Freya|	"Yes, it's quite an honor."|109|0
units.english: "Yes, it's quite an honor."
units.italian: "Sì, è un bell'onore."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Freya|	"Yes, it's hard to know what to do with myself now that no one wants to kill me."|111|0
units.english: "Yes, it's hard to know what to do with myself now that no one wants to kill me."
units.italian: "Sì, è difficile sapere che cosa fare di me stesso ora che nessuno vuole uccidermi."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Freya|	"Right. Just remember, none of it would have happened without me, okay? Not that I have any desire to be a hero; that sort of public attention would be pretty much my worst nightmare."|115|0
units.english: "Right. Just remember, none of it would have happened without me, okay? Not that I have any desire to be a hero; that sort of public attention would be pretty much my worst nightmare."
units.italian: "Giusto. Ricordati solo che niente di tutto questo sarebbe successo senza di me, va bene? Non che abbia desiderio di fare l'eroe; quel tipo di attenzione pubblica sarebbe praticamente il mio peggior incubo."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Freya|	"Well, I'm sure you can find something interesting to do," she says. "Go fight some pirates. Or become a business mogul and get filthy rich. Whatever floats your boat."|119|0
units.english: "Well, I'm sure you can find something interesting to do," she says. "Go fight some pirates. Or become a business mogul and get filthy rich. Whatever floats your boat."
units.italian: "Beh, sono sicura che troverai qualcosa di interessante da fare," dice. "Vai a combattere qualche pirata. O diventa un magnate degli affari e fatti ricco sfondato. Quello che ti pare."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Freya|	"What have you found out about the Pug?" you ask.|123|0
units.english: "What have you found out about the Pug?" you ask.
units.italian: "Che cosa avete scoperto sui Pug?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Freya|	"Not much," she says. "The wormhole doesn't seem to lead to their real home; it's just another red herring. The real breakthrough, of course, would be if we could find some hints in the stuff they left behind about how to build more jump drives of our own. But so far, we can't even figure out how to create new hyperspace links where there wasn't one originally. I'm starting to think that those graviton transmitters we used were just one more game - a toy, not the real thing. Not what created the links in the first place, I mean, unless they were created by someone with the patience to wait a million years for them to work."|124|0
units.english: "Not much," she says. "The wormhole doesn't seem to lead to their real home; it's just another red herring. The real breakthrough, of course, would be if we could find some hints in the stuff they left behind about how to build more jump drives of our own. But so far, we can't even figure out how to create new hyperspace links where there wasn't one originally. I'm starting to think that those graviton transmitters we used were just one more game - a toy, not the real thing. Not what created the links in the first place, I mean, unless they were created by someone with the patience to wait a million years for them to work."
units.italian: "Non molto," dice. "Il wormhole non sembra portare alla loro vera casa; è solo un'altra pista falsa. Il vero passo avanti, naturalmente, sarebbe se riuscissimo a trovare qualche indizio, nelle cose che hanno lasciato, su come costruire da soli altri motori di salto. Ma finora non riusciamo nemmeno a capire come creare nuovi collegamenti iperspaziali dove prima non ce n'erano. Comincio a pensare che quei trasmettitori di gravitoni che abbiamo usato fossero solo un altro gioco: un giocattolo, non la cosa vera. Intendo dire, non ciò che ha creato i collegamenti in primo luogo, a meno che non li abbia creati qualcuno con la pazienza di aspettare un milione di anni perché funzionassero."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Freya|	"Have you found any other interesting technology?"|126|0
units.english: "Have you found any other interesting technology?"
units.italian: "Avete trovato qualche altra tecnologia interessante?"

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Freya|	"Any more hints about who the Pug were and what they wanted?"|128|0
units.english: "Any more hints about who the Pug were and what they wanted?"
units.italian: "Ci sono altri indizi su chi fossero i Pug e che cosa volessero?"

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Freya|	"Some," she says. "Everything they left behind is like, well... an educational toy. Like some absent parent left behind a super-advanced chemistry set for their kids to play with. That's how all the artifacts we find here feel - not like the real thing that the Pug would have used, but like a simplified model that they gave us to help us figure it out. Everything they left behind, I'm convinced they left intentionally, because it could teach us something they wanted us to know, while keeping all their true secrets secret. The rest of you moved on, and I'm still here playing their game."|132|0
units.english: "Some," she says. "Everything they left behind is like, well... an educational toy. Like some absent parent left behind a super-advanced chemistry set for their kids to play with. That's how all the artifacts we find here feel - not like the real thing that the Pug would have used, but like a simplified model that they gave us to help us figure it out. Everything they left behind, I'm convinced they left intentionally, because it could teach us something they wanted us to know, while keeping all their true secrets secret. The rest of you moved on, and I'm still here playing their game."
units.italian: "Alcuni," dice. "Tutto quello che hanno lasciato è come, beh... un giocattolo didattico. Come un genitore distratto che lascia ai figli un set di chimica superavanzato per giocarci. Ecco come ci sembrano tutti i reperti che troviamo qui: non la cosa vera che i Pug avrebbero usato, ma un modello semplificato che ci hanno dato per aiutarci a capirla. Tutto quello che hanno lasciato, sono convinta che l'abbiano lasciato di proposito, perché poteva insegnarci qualcosa che volevano sapessimo, tenendo segreti tutti i loro veri segreti. Voi altri siete andati avanti, e io sono ancora qui a giocare al loro gioco."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Freya|	"Not much," she says. "This world - it feels like when you're visiting a friend's house, and they spent the whole day cleaning up for you. It's not like a person's home is when you drop by unannounced. Nothing's out of place. Everything that's lying out somewhere, is something they wanted you to see. There's some weird technology they left behind, but all of it is like toys, puzzles... I don't know, like an educational game they designed for us to play. The rest of you moved on, and I'm still here playing their game."|136|0
units.english: "Not much," she says. "This world - it feels like when you're visiting a friend's house, and they spent the whole day cleaning up for you. It's not like a person's home is when you drop by unannounced. Nothing's out of place. Everything that's lying out somewhere, is something they wanted you to see. There's some weird technology they left behind, but all of it is like toys, puzzles... I don't know, like an educational game they designed for us to play. The rest of you moved on, and I'm still here playing their game."
units.italian: "Non molto," dice. "Questo mondo mi fa pensare a quando vai a casa di un amico e lui ha passato la giornata a pulire per te. Non è come la casa di una persona quando arrivi senza avvisare. Non c'è niente fuori posto. Tutto quello che è lasciato in giro è qualcosa che volevano che tu vedessi. C'è qualche tecnologia strana che hanno lasciato, ma è tutta roba come giocattoli, enigmi... non so, come un gioco didattico che hanno progettato perché noi lo giocassimo. Voi altri siete andati avanti, e io sono ancora qui a giocare al loro gioco."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Freya|	"You sound frustrated."|141|0
units.english: "You sound frustrated."
units.italian: "Sembri frustrata."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Freya|	"You know, the war is over, you can relax if you want to."|142|0
units.english: "You know, the war is over, you can relax if you want to."
units.italian: "Sai, la guerra è finita, puoi rilassarti se vuoi."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Freya|	"I know, I know," she says. "I complain, but really there's nowhere else I would rather be. Even if everything we're discovering here is nothing more than what they intended for us to discover, it's still the most interesting work I could possibly be doing right now. So, don't feel sorry for me. Really."|143|0
units.english: "I know, I know," she says. "I complain, but really there's nowhere else I would rather be. Even if everything we're discovering here is nothing more than what they intended for us to discover, it's still the most interesting work I could possibly be doing right now. So, don't feel sorry for me. Really."
units.italian: "Lo so, lo so," dice. "Mi lamento, ma in realtà non c'è nessun altro posto dove preferirei essere. Anche se tutto quello che scopriamo qui non è niente più di quello che volevano che scoprissimo, resta il lavoro più interessante che potrei fare in questo momento. Quindi non dispiacerti per me. Davvero."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Freya|	You talk for a while longer, and she tells you she'll be sure to be in touch if they ever get to the root of the Pug's motivation. "Until then," she says, "good luck in your travels. I hope the galaxy never runs out of ways to surprise you."|146|0
units.english: You talk for a while longer, and she tells you she'll be sure to be in touch if they ever get to the root of the Pug's motivation. "Until then," she says, "good luck in your travels. I hope the galaxy never runs out of ways to surprise you."
units.italian: Parlate ancora un po', e lei ti dice che si farà sicuramente viva se mai arriveranno alla radice delle motivazioni dei Pug. "Fino ad allora," dice, "buona fortuna nei tuoi viaggi. Spero che alla galassia non manchino mai i modi di sorprenderti."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Freya|	"By the way, can I ask you something, <first>? About you? Sorry if this is rather abrupt. I've been too busy to talk during the war."|150|0
units.english: "By the way, can I ask you something, <first>? About you? Sorry if this is rather abrupt. I've been too busy to talk during the war."
units.italian: "A proposito, posso chiederti una cosa, <first>? Su di te? Scusa se è piuttosto brusco. Sono stata troppo impegnata per parlare durante la guerra."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Freya|	"Sure. What is it?"|152|0
units.english: "Sure. What is it?"
units.italian: "Certo. Di che si tratta?"

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Freya|	"Sorry, I'd prefer if you didn't."|154|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'd prefer if you didn't."
units.italian: "Scusa, preferirei di no."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Freya|	"Do you happen to know anyone named Lavinia? Married to someone named Marcus?"|158|0
units.english: "Do you happen to know anyone named Lavinia? Married to someone named Marcus?"
units.italian: "Conosci per caso qualcuno di nome Lavinia? Sposata con uno di nome Marcus?"

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Freya|	Both names sound oddly familiar, but you can't remember where you heard them.|159|0
units.english: Both names sound oddly familiar, but you can't remember where you heard them.
units.italian: Entrambi i nomi ti suonano stranamente familiari, ma non ricordi dove li hai sentiti.

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Freya|	"I think so, but I need a minute to remember exactly who."|161|0
units.english: "I think so, but I need a minute to remember exactly who."
units.italian: "Credo di sì, ma mi serve un minuto per ricordare esattamente chi."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Freya|	"No, I don't."|163|0
units.english: "No, I don't."
units.italian: "No, non li conosco."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Freya|	"Oh, okay. I think I've been mistaken, then. Never mind."|166|0
units.english: "Oh, okay. I think I've been mistaken, then. Never mind."
units.italian: "Oh, va bene. Allora credo di essermi sbagliata. Non importa."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Freya|	You try to recall exactly where you've heard those names before, racking your brain for any information on these vaguely familiar names, then all of a sudden, it hits you. Marcus and Lavinia were two of your great-grandparents. You wonder why someone you've never met until around the time you joined the Free Worlds is suddenly asking about your ancestors. Maybe she was thinking of a different Marcus and Lavinia.|169|0
units.english: You try to recall exactly where you've heard those names before, racking your brain for any information on these vaguely familiar names, then all of a sudden, it hits you. Marcus and Lavinia were two of your great-grandparents. You wonder why someone you've never met until around the time you joined the Free Worlds is suddenly asking about your ancestors. Maybe she was thinking of a different Marcus and Lavinia.
units.italian: Cerchi di ricordare esattamente dove hai sentito quei nomi, spremendoti le meningi per qualsiasi informazione su quei nomi vagamente familiari, e all'improvviso ti colpisce. Marcus e Lavinia erano due dei tuoi bisnonni. Ti chiedi perché qualcuno che non hai mai conosciuto fino a quando ti sei unito alle Free Worlds ti stia chiedendo dei tuoi antenati. Magari stava pensando a un altro Marcus e a un'altra Lavinia.

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Freya|	"Yeah, I do know a Marcus and Lavinia, but they're my great-grandparents. Are you sure you're asking the right person?" you ask.|170|0
units.english: "Yeah, I do know a Marcus and Lavinia, but they're my great-grandparents. Are you sure you're asking the right person?" you ask.
units.italian: "Sì, conosco un Marcus e una Lavinia, ma sono i miei bisnonni. Sei sicura di aver chiesto alla persona giusta?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Freya|	"Oh my God," Freya says. "I can't believe it."|171|0
units.english: "Oh my God," Freya says. "I can't believe it."
units.italian: "Oh, mio Dio," dice Freya. "Non ci posso credere."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Freya|	"What?"|172|0
units.english: "What?"
units.italian: "Che cosa?"

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Freya|	"I think we're related. Second cousins. Marcus and Lavinia Winters are also my great-grandparents."|173|0
units.english: "I think we're related. Second cousins. Marcus and Lavinia Winters are also my great-grandparents."
units.italian: "Credo che siamo parenti. Cugini di secondo grado. Marcus e Lavinia Winters sono anche i miei bisnonni."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Freya|	"Really?"|175|0
units.english: "Really?"
units.italian: "Davvero?"

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Freya|	"Well, then, hello, cousin. Nice to meet you."|177|0
units.english: "Well, then, hello, cousin. Nice to meet you."
units.italian: "Beh, allora ciao, cugino. Piacere di conoscerti."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Freya|	"Yeah, I can hardly believe it myself. I think it's nice, though. A pleasant surprise." You agree.|180|0
units.english: "Yeah, I can hardly believe it myself. I think it's nice, though. A pleasant surprise." You agree.
units.italian: "Sì, anch'io faccio fatica a crederci. Però mi fa piacere. Una sorpresa gradita." Sei d'accordo.

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Freya|	"Heh. Nice to meet you, too. Looks like we brought some prestige to the Winters family name, haven't we, cousin?"|184|0
units.english: "Heh. Nice to meet you, too. Looks like we brought some prestige to the Winters family name, haven't we, cousin?"
units.italian: "Eh. Piacere mio. A quanto pare abbiamo portato un po' di prestigio al cognome Winters, eh, cugino?"

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Freya|	You both laugh at her reply.|185|0
units.english: You both laugh at her reply.
units.italian: Ridete entrambi della sua risposta.

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Freya|	"Never thought I'd go about saving the galaxy with a second cousin I'd never met," she continues, "but in a war where some previously-unknown hyperlane-manipulating aliens intervene to try and make both sides unite, I guess anything's possible."|186|0
units.english: "Never thought I'd go about saving the galaxy with a second cousin I'd never met," she continues, "but in a war where some previously-unknown hyperlane-manipulating aliens intervene to try and make both sides unite, I guess anything's possible."
units.italian: "Non avrei mai pensato di andare in giro a salvare la galassia con una cugina di secondo grado che non avevo mai conosciuto," continua, "ma in una guerra dove alieni mai visti che manipolano i corridoi iperspaziali intervengono per provare a far unire le due parti, immagino che tutto sia possibile."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Freya|	You talk for a while longer, and she tells you she'll be sure to be in touch if they ever get to the root of the Pug's motivation. "Until then," she says, "good luck in your travels. I hope the galaxy never runs out of ways to surprise you."|189|0
units.english: You talk for a while longer, and she tells you she'll be sure to be in touch if they ever get to the root of the Pug's motivation. "Until then," she says, "good luck in your travels. I hope the galaxy never runs out of ways to surprise you."
units.italian: Parlate ancora un po', e lei ti dice che si farà sicuramente viva se mai arriveranno alla radice delle motivazioni dei Pug. "Fino ad allora," dice, "buona fortuna nei tuoi viaggi. Spero che alla galassia non manchino mai i modi di sorprenderti."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Danforth|Would you like to stop by and see how Admiral Danforth is doing?|203|0
units.english: Would you like to stop by and see how Admiral Danforth is doing?
units.italian: Vuoi passare a vedere come sta l'ammiraglio Danforth?

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Danforth|	(Yes.)|205|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Danforth|	(Not right now.)|206|0
units.english: (Not right now.)
units.italian: (Non adesso.)

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Danforth|	Danforth is quite excited to see you. "Captain <last>!" he says. "So good to see you back up here in my neck of the woods again. It's funny, you'd think that with the war over they'd just dissolve the Oathkeepers, since the whole Republic is at peace with the Free Worlds and there's no longer any oath left for us to keep. But, the Oathkeepers became so well known for our role against the Pug and the Syndicate that now everyone wants to join our division."|211|0
units.english: Danforth is quite excited to see you. "Captain <last>!" he says. "So good to see you back up here in my neck of the woods again. It's funny, you'd think that with the war over they'd just dissolve the Oathkeepers, since the whole Republic is at peace with the Free Worlds and there's no longer any oath left for us to keep. But, the Oathkeepers became so well known for our role against the Pug and the Syndicate that now everyone wants to join our division."
units.italian: Danforth è piuttosto emozionato di vederti. "Capitano <last>!" dice. "Che bello rivederti quassù dalle mie parti. È buffo, verrebbe da pensare che, con la guerra finita, scioglierebbero gli Oathkeepers, visto che l'intera Repubblica è in pace con le Free Worlds e non ci resta più nessun giuramento da mantenere. Ma gli Oathkeepers sono diventati così noti per il nostro ruolo contro i Pug e il Sindacato che ora tutti vogliono entrare nella nostra divisione."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Danforth|	Danforth is quite excited to see you. "Captain <last>!" he says. "So good to see you back up here in my neck of the woods again. It's funny, you'd think that with the war over they'd just dissolve the Oathkeepers, since the whole Republic is at peace with the Free Worlds and there's no longer any oath left for us to keep. But, the Oathkeepers became so well known for our role against the Pug that now everyone wants to join our division."|215|0
units.english: Danforth is quite excited to see you. "Captain <last>!" he says. "So good to see you back up here in my neck of the woods again. It's funny, you'd think that with the war over they'd just dissolve the Oathkeepers, since the whole Republic is at peace with the Free Worlds and there's no longer any oath left for us to keep. But, the Oathkeepers became so well known for our role against the Pug that now everyone wants to join our division."
units.italian: Danforth è piuttosto emozionato di vederti. "Capitano <last>!" dice. "Che bello rivederti quassù dalle mie parti. È buffo, verrebbe da pensare che, con la guerra finita, scioglierebbero gli Oathkeepers, visto che l'intera Repubblica è in pace con le Free Worlds e non ci resta più nessun giuramento da mantenere. Ma gli Oathkeepers sono diventati così noti per il nostro ruolo contro i Pug che ora tutti vogliono entrare nella nostra divisione."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Danforth|	"Glad to see you're still in the thick of things, sir!"|219|0
units.english: "Glad to see you're still in the thick of things, sir!"
units.italian: "Sono contento di vedere che è ancora nel mezzo delle cose, signore!"

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Danforth|	"What sort of work is the Navy doing now that we're at peace?"|221|0
units.english: "What sort of work is the Navy doing now that we're at peace?"
units.italian: "Che tipo di lavoro fa la Marina ora che siamo in pace?"

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Danforth|	"Oh, you bet I am," he says. "I'll never retire from the Navy, you know. I plan to still be serving on the day I die."|225|0
units.english: "Oh, you bet I am," he says. "I'll never retire from the Navy, you know. I plan to still be serving on the day I die."
units.italian: "Oh, puoi scommetterci," dice. "Non andrò mai in pensione dalla Marina, sai. Conto di essere ancora in servizio il giorno in cui morirò."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Danforth|	"Just the sort of work we all signed up for in the first place," he says. "Defending the defenseless, keeping the peace, helping silly novice pilots who run out of fuel."|229|0
units.english: "Just the sort of work we all signed up for in the first place," he says. "Defending the defenseless, keeping the peace, helping silly novice pilots who run out of fuel."
units.italian: "Proprio il tipo di lavoro per cui ci siamo arruolati tutti fin dall'inizio," dice. "Difendere chi non può difendersi, mantenere la pace, aiutare i piloti principianti che finiscono il carburante."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Danforth|	"Are the pirates giving you any trouble?" you ask.|233|0
units.english: "Are the pirates giving you any trouble?" you ask.
units.italian: "I pirati ti danno problemi?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Danforth|	"A bit," he says. "We still have far too many pirates in this sector, in part due to the Free Worlds mostly driving them out of the South. The pirates grew stronger and more bold as the war dragged on, when all our fleets were busy elsewhere, but now we're beginning to get them under control again."|234|0
units.english: "A bit," he says. "We still have far too many pirates in this sector, in part due to the Free Worlds mostly driving them out of the South. The pirates grew stronger and more bold as the war dragged on, when all our fleets were busy elsewhere, but now we're beginning to get them under control again."
units.italian: "Un po'," dice. "In questo settore ci sono ancora troppi pirati, in parte perché le Free Worlds li hanno per lo più scacciati dal Sud. I pirati sono diventati più forti e più audaci man mano che la guerra si trascinava, quando tutte le nostre flotte erano impegnate altrove, ma ora stiamo ricominciando a tenerli sotto controllo."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Danforth|	Then he leans forward and says, more quietly, "Of course, you and I both know the pirates aren't the main threat. Raven is off infiltrating Syndicate worlds even as we speak, and several of my other best intelligence officers, too. The Syndicate wants us to believe that they've weeded out all the rotten apples from their ranks, but we're keeping an eye on them, all the same."|238|0
units.english: Then he leans forward and says, more quietly, "Of course, you and I both know the pirates aren't the main threat. Raven is off infiltrating Syndicate worlds even as we speak, and several of my other best intelligence officers, too. The Syndicate wants us to believe that they've weeded out all the rotten apples from their ranks, but we're keeping an eye on them, all the same."
units.italian: Poi si sporge in avanti e dice, più sottovoce: "Naturalmente, tu ed io sappiamo che i pirati non sono la minaccia principale. Raven è in missione sotto copertura nei mondi del Sindacato proprio mentre parliamo, e anche diversi altri miei migliori ufficiali dell'intelligence. Il Sindacato vuole farci credere di aver eliminato tutte le mele marce dalle sue file, ma teniamo comunque d'occhio la situazione."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Danforth|	Then he leans forward and says, more quietly, "Just a heads-up that the Navy has their eye on the Free Worlds still. Just because a peace treaty was made doesn't mean you can keep your nukes forever."|242|0
units.english: Then he leans forward and says, more quietly, "Just a heads-up that the Navy has their eye on the Free Worlds still. Just because a peace treaty was made doesn't mean you can keep your nukes forever."
units.italian: Poi si sporge in avanti e dice, più sottovoce: "Solo per avvisarti che la Marina tiene ancora d'occhio le Free Worlds. Il fatto che sia stato firmato un trattato di pace non significa che potete tenervi le testate nucleari per sempre."

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Danforth|	After you talk for a while longer, Danforth wishes you luck and sends you on your way. "I'll be in touch if we ever need your assistance in the future," he says.|245|0
units.english: After you talk for a while longer, Danforth wishes you luck and sends you on your way. "I'll be in touch if we ever need your assistance in the future," he says.
units.italian: Dopo che avete parlato ancora un po', Danforth ti augura buona fortuna e ti congeda. "Ti contatterò se in futuro avremo bisogno del tuo aiuto," dice.

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Edward|name|252|0
units.english: Weapon Testing
units.italian: Prova delle armi

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Edward|description|253|0
units.english: A test ship with new weaponry is in orbit around <planet>. Fight and disable it (but do not board or destroy it!) and then land to give Barmy Edward feedback on its performance.
units.italian: Una nave di prova con nuove armi è in orbita intorno a <planet>. Combattila e mettila fuori uso (ma non abbordarla né distruggerla!) e poi atterra per dare a Barmy Edward un parere sulle sue prestazioni.

units.id: mission:FW Epilogue: Edward|log|266|0
units.english: Assisted Barmy Edward with another weapon test: this time, an impressive upgrade to the Plasma Cannon. Increased fire rate, even at lower damage per hit, comes out with better overall results.
units.italian: Hai assistito Barmy Edward in un'altra prova d'arma: questa volta un notevole miglioramento del cannone al plasma. Cadenza di fuoco aumentata, anche a fronte di un danno per colpo inferiore, con risultati complessivi migliori.

units.id: conversation:edward epilogue|As you complete your landing procedure, you recall having come here to assist in some testing for new weapons, back in the thick of the war. Do you want to check in on Barmy Edward, the lead engineer?|275|0
units.english: As you complete your landing procedure, you recall having come here to assist in some testing for new weapons, back in the thick of the war. Do you want to check in on Barmy Edward, the lead engineer?
units.italian: Mentre completi la procedura di atterraggio, ricordi di essere venuto qui per assistere alle prove di nuove armi, nel pieno della guerra. Vuoi passare a salutare Barmy Edward, l'ingegnere capo?

units.id: conversation:edward epilogue|	(Yes.)|277|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: conversation:edward epilogue|	(No.)|278|0
units.english: (No.)
units.italian: (No.)

units.id: conversation:edward epilogue|	You give your name to the receptionist, and she directs you to a hangar where you find Barmy Edward, who is working on a weapon that looks like a modified Plasma Cannon. When he notices you, he gets up from his work and shakes your hand warmly. "Ah, <last>. It's been too long! How fortunate for me! I'm actually just putting the finishing touches on a new prototype. You wouldn't be too busy to assist me in some practical testing, would you?"|281|0
units.english: You give your name to the receptionist, and she directs you to a hangar where you find Barmy Edward, who is working on a weapon that looks like a modified Plasma Cannon. When he notices you, he gets up from his work and shakes your hand warmly. "Ah, <last>. It's been too long! How fortunate for me! I'm actually just putting the finishing touches on a new prototype. You wouldn't be too busy to assist me in some practical testing, would you?"
units.italian: Dici il tuo nome alla reception, e lei ti indirizza a un hangar dove trovi Barmy Edward, al lavoro su un'arma che sembra un cannone al plasma modificato. Quando ti nota, si alza dal lavoro e ti stringe la mano con calore. "Ah, <last>. È passato troppo tempo! Che fortuna per me! Sto proprio dando gli ultimi ritocchi a un nuovo prototipo. Non sarai mica troppo impegnato per assistermi in qualche prova pratica, vero?"

units.id: conversation:edward epilogue|	"I'm not sure about this. What would you have me do?"|283|0
units.english: "I'm not sure about this. What would you have me do?"
units.italian: "Non ne sono sicuro. Che cosa dovrei fare?"

units.id: conversation:edward epilogue|	"Being a target for experimental weapons? Just tell me what you need!"|284|0
units.english: "Being a target for experimental weapons? Just tell me what you need!"
units.italian: "Fare da bersaglio per armi sperimentali? Dimmi solo di che cosa hai bisogno!"

units.id: conversation:edward epilogue|	"Not much out of the ordinary from our tests in the past," he replies. "You'll find a ship of ours in orbit that goes by <npc>. It's been fitted with a few of these new weapons. Your job will be to fight and disable it, tell us what you think of its combat capabilities, and transfer your ship's logs so we can analyze the fight."|285|0
units.english: "Not much out of the ordinary from our tests in the past," he replies. "You'll find a ship of ours in orbit that goes by <npc>. It's been fitted with a few of these new weapons. Your job will be to fight and disable it, tell us what you think of its combat capabilities, and transfer your ship's logs so we can analyze the fight."
units.italian: "Niente di molto diverso dalle nostre prove del passato," risponde. "In orbita troverai una nostra nave che si chiama <npc>. È stata equipaggiata con alcune di queste nuove armi. Il tuo compito sarà combatterla e metterla fuori uso, dirci che cosa pensi delle sue capacità di combattimento, e trasferire i registri della tua nave perché possiamo analizzare lo scontro."

units.id: conversation:edward epilogue|	"Alright, I suppose for old times' sake I can help out."|287|0
units.english: "Alright, I suppose for old times' sake I can help out."
units.italian: "Va bene, immagino che per i vecchi tempi posso dare una mano."

units.id: conversation:edward epilogue|	"Sorry, I just wanted to check in and see how you were doing."|288|0
units.english: "Sorry, I just wanted to check in and see how you were doing."
units.italian: "Scusa, volevo solo passare a vedere come stavi."

units.id: conversation:edward epilogue|	He turns to you and smirks. "We've recommissioned the ship from retirement, so it's not top of the line, but try to keep it in one piece for future use. Understand?"|290|0
units.english: He turns to you and smirks. "We've recommissioned the ship from retirement, so it's not top of the line, but try to keep it in one piece for future use. Understand?"
units.italian: Si volta verso di te con un sorrisetto. "Abbiamo rimesso in servizio la nave dal pensionamento, quindi non è il massimo, ma cerca di tenerla intera per usi futuri. Chiaro?"

units.id: conversation:edward epilogue|	"Of course! I'll take care of it."|292|0
units.english: "Of course! I'll take care of it."
units.italian: "Certo! Me ne prenderò cura."

units.id: conversation:edward epilogue|	"Great," he says, rubbing his hands together with a gleeful expression on his face. He's clearly looking forward to hearing what you think of his latest invention.|293|0
units.english: "Great," he says, rubbing his hands together with a gleeful expression on his face. He's clearly looking forward to hearing what you think of his latest invention.
units.italian: "Ottimo," dice, strofinandosi le mani con un'espressione compiaciuta. È chiaramente impaziente di sentire che cosa pensi della sua ultima invenzione.

units.id: conversation:edward epilogue|	"I see. Well, I'm sure we can find someone else up to the task. Regardless, Captain <last>, I assure you this new weapon vastly improves on the outdated Plasma Cannon. This'll put Kraz Cybernetics in the big leagues!"|296|0
units.english: "I see. Well, I'm sure we can find someone else up to the task. Regardless, Captain <last>, I assure you this new weapon vastly improves on the outdated Plasma Cannon. This'll put Kraz Cybernetics in the big leagues!"
units.italian: "Capisco. Beh, sono sicuro che troveremo qualcun altro all'altezza del compito. In ogni caso, capitano <last>, ti assicuro che questa nuova arma migliora di molto l'obsoleto cannone al plasma. Metterà la Kraz Cybernetics nella serie A!"

units.id: conversation:edward epilogue|	"How about we get out of here, <first>? My work is done for today, and I know a homely little bar that's only a short walk."|297|0
units.english: "How about we get out of here, <first>? My work is done for today, and I know a homely little bar that's only a short walk."
units.italian: "Che ne dici di andarcene da qui, <first>? Per oggi ho finito, e conosco un bar modesto che è a due passi."

units.id: conversation:edward epilogue|	"Of course. It's not like there's a war to worry about anymore."|299|0
units.english: "Of course. It's not like there's a war to worry about anymore."
units.italian: "Certo. Non è che ci sia più una guerra di cui preoccuparsi."

units.id: conversation:edward epilogue|	"Ha! Well, of course, the war kept all of us plenty busy." He leads you out of the facility while telling an anecdote that must be humor for an engineer.|300|0
units.english: "Ha! Well, of course, the war kept all of us plenty busy." He leads you out of the facility while telling an anecdote that must be humor for an engineer.
units.italian: "Ah! Beh, certo, la guerra ci ha tenuti tutti parecchio impegnati." Ti accompagna fuori dalla struttura raccontando un aneddoto che dev'essere umorismo da ingegnere.

units.id: conversation:edward epilogue|You head to the hangar to meet up with Barmy Edward, and find him tinkering with the modified Plasma Cannon you saw when you first entered. "It runs much hotter, you see," he explains. "But the results are impressive."|305|0
units.english: You head to the hangar to meet up with Barmy Edward, and find him tinkering with the modified Plasma Cannon you saw when you first entered. "It runs much hotter, you see," he explains. "But the results are impressive."
units.italian: Ti dirigi all'hangar per incontrare Barmy Edward, e lo trovi che armeggia con il cannone al plasma modificato che avevi visto appena entrato. "Scalda molto di più, vedi," spiega. "Ma i risultati sono notevoli."

units.id: conversation:edward epilogue|	"Was that a plasma cannon? Or something else?"|307|0
units.english: "Was that a plasma cannon? Or something else?"
units.italian: "Era un cannone al plasma? O qualcos'altro?"

units.id: conversation:edward epilogue|	"It's not winning any damage records, that's for sure."|309|0
units.english: "It's not winning any damage records, that's for sure."
units.italian: "Non batterà certo nessun record di danno, questo è sicuro."

units.id: conversation:edward epilogue|	"Heh, it's been a while since we've seen a good upgrade to the cannon," he says. "That was the Plasma Repeater. Of course, it wasn't easy to make a better iteration of something that countless fools have failed to improve on."|312|0
units.english: "Heh, it's been a while since we've seen a good upgrade to the cannon," he says. "That was the Plasma Repeater. Of course, it wasn't easy to make a better iteration of something that countless fools have failed to improve on."
units.italian: "Eh, era un po' che non vedevamo un buon miglioramento del cannone," dice. "Era il Ripetitore al plasma. Naturalmente non è stato facile fare una versione migliore di qualcosa su cui innumerevoli sciocchi hanno fallito."

units.id: conversation:edward epilogue|	"When will it be available for sale?" you ask.|313|0
units.english: "When will it be available for sale?" you ask.
units.italian: "Quando sarà in vendita?" chiedi.

units.id: conversation:edward epilogue|	"Well, you are one of the revered captains that drove off the Pug," he says. "The idea is that by shrinking the bolts of superheated plasma, we can offload many more bursts onto a target. The effects on said target result in faster buildup of heat and, of course, damage. Big ships will usually ward off these effects much longer than a smaller ship would, but that's always been a notable issue with the original design. Besides, the repeater is a hell of a lot more impressive."|316|0
units.english: "Well, you are one of the revered captains that drove off the Pug," he says. "The idea is that by shrinking the bolts of superheated plasma, we can offload many more bursts onto a target. The effects on said target result in faster buildup of heat and, of course, damage. Big ships will usually ward off these effects much longer than a smaller ship would, but that's always been a notable issue with the original design. Besides, the repeater is a hell of a lot more impressive."
units.italian: "Beh, sei uno dei capitani venerati che hanno scacciato i Pug," dice. "L'idea è che, riducendo i proiettili di plasma surriscaldato, possiamo scaricare molti più colpi su un bersaglio. Gli effetti sul bersaglio si traducono in un accumulo più rapido di calore e, naturalmente, in danni. Le navi grandi di solito resistono a questi effetti molto più a lungo di una nave piccola, ma è sempre stato un problema notevole del progetto originale. Inoltre il ripetitore è dannatamente più impressionante."

units.id: conversation:edward epilogue|	"That's a unique direction," you reply. "Are they available for sale yet?"|317|0
units.english: "That's a unique direction," you reply. "Are they available for sale yet?"
units.italian: "È una direzione originale," rispondi. "Sono già in vendita?"

units.id: conversation:edward epilogue|	"Thanks to you, it should be in stock in a few months," he answers. "I'm sure you're past the point where our weapons are useful, but then again, not everybody has a jump drive." He grins. "How about we celebrate with some drinks? I know a quaint little bar not far from here."|319|0
units.english: "Thanks to you, it should be in stock in a few months," he answers. "I'm sure you're past the point where our weapons are useful, but then again, not everybody has a jump drive." He grins. "How about we celebrate with some drinks? I know a quaint little bar not far from here."
units.italian: "Grazie a te, dovrebbero essere disponibili entro qualche mese," risponde. "Sono sicuro che hai ormai superato il punto in cui le nostre armi sono utili, ma del resto non tutti hanno un motore di salto." Sorride. "Che ne dici di festeggiare con qualche drink? Conosco un baretto grazioso non lontano da qui."

units.id: conversation:edward epilogue|	"I have time; let's celebrate!"|321|0
units.english: "I have time; let's celebrate!"
units.italian: "Ho tempo; festeggiamo!"

units.id: conversation:edward epilogue|	"I'll pass on that, but it was good checking in on you."|322|0
units.english: "I'll pass on that, but it was good checking in on you."
units.italian: "Passo, ma è stato bello vedere come stai."

units.id: conversation:edward epilogue|	You follow Barmy into the bar. Even with the smear of grease still on his face, he fits in with the crowd. You both stand at the bar and order your drinks. Barmy's order catches you off guard, and he notices your expression. "What? A man who works with his hands can't enjoy a drink with some age?" You chuckle, and you both tell stories of your early lives. He tells how he had some exciting adventures in his youth among the stars, but found his passion tinkering and finding ways to improve on outdated equipment.|328|0
units.english: You follow Barmy into the bar. Even with the smear of grease still on his face, he fits in with the crowd. You both stand at the bar and order your drinks. Barmy's order catches you off guard, and he notices your expression. "What? A man who works with his hands can't enjoy a drink with some age?" You chuckle, and you both tell stories of your early lives. He tells how he had some exciting adventures in his youth among the stars, but found his passion tinkering and finding ways to improve on outdated equipment.
units.italian: Segui Barmy nel bar. Anche con la macchia di grasso ancora sul viso, si trova a suo agio fra la gente. State entrambi al bancone e ordinate da bere. L'ordine di Barmy ti coglie di sorpresa, e lui se ne accorge dall'espressione. "Che c'è? Un uomo che lavora con le mani non può gustarsi un drink un po' invecchiato?" Ridacchi, e raccontate entrambi storie dei vostri primi anni. Racconta di alcune avventure emozionanti della sua giovinezza fra le stelle, ma di aver trovato la sua passione nell'armeggiare e nel trovare modi per migliorare equipaggiamenti obsoleti.

units.id: conversation:edward epilogue|	He's shocked to discover your origins on New Boston. "You're really from that backwater planet? I'm surprised you were able to escape the racket they have going on there. I was lucky to get out myself!"|329|0
units.english: He's shocked to discover your origins on New Boston. "You're really from that backwater planet? I'm surprised you were able to escape the racket they have going on there. I was lucky to get out myself!"
units.italian: Resta sbalordito nello scoprire le tue origini su New Boston. "Vieni davvero da quel pianeta sperduto? Mi sorprende che tu sia riuscito a sfuggire al baccano che hanno lì. Io sono stato fortunato a uscirne!"

units.id: conversation:edward epilogue|	"Wait, you're from New Boston too?"|331|0
units.english: "Wait, you're from New Boston too?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, anche tu vieni da New Boston?"

units.id: conversation:edward epilogue|	"It wasn't perfect there, but at least it wasn't quite so noisy down on the ground."|332|0
units.english: "It wasn't perfect there, but at least it wasn't quite so noisy down on the ground."
units.italian: "Non era perfetto, ma almeno non era così rumoroso laggiù in basso."

units.id: conversation:edward epilogue|	"Nothing like it is now. I've got the whole universe ahead of me!"|334|0
units.english: "Nothing like it is now. I've got the whole universe ahead of me!"
units.italian: "Niente a che vedere con com'è adesso. Ho tutto l'universo davanti a me!"

units.id: conversation:edward epilogue|	"You wouldn't think to have met someone from your very own birth planet, eh?" He chuckles. "Small galaxy, I suppose."|336|0
units.english: "You wouldn't think to have met someone from your very own birth planet, eh?" He chuckles. "Small galaxy, I suppose."
units.italian: "Non avresti mai pensato di incontrare qualcuno del tuo stesso pianeta natale, eh?" Ridacchia. "Galassia piccola, immagino."

units.id: conversation:edward epilogue|	You follow Barmy into the bar. Even with the smear of grease still on his face, he fits in with the crowd. You both stand at the bar and order your drinks. Barmy's order catches you off guard, and he notices your expression. "What? A man who works with his hands can't enjoy a drink with some age?" You chuckle, and you both tell stories of your early lives. He tells you about his upbringing on the Dirt Belt world of New Boston, and how he had some exciting adventures in his youth among the stars, but found his passion tinkering and finding ways to improve on outdated equipment.|339|0
units.english: You follow Barmy into the bar. Even with the smear of grease still on his face, he fits in with the crowd. You both stand at the bar and order your drinks. Barmy's order catches you off guard, and he notices your expression. "What? A man who works with his hands can't enjoy a drink with some age?" You chuckle, and you both tell stories of your early lives. He tells you about his upbringing on the Dirt Belt world of New Boston, and how he had some exciting adventures in his youth among the stars, but found his passion tinkering and finding ways to improve on outdated equipment.
units.italian: Segui Barmy nel bar. Anche con la macchia di grasso ancora sul viso, si trova a suo agio fra la gente. State entrambi al bancone e ordinate da bere. L'ordine di Barmy ti coglie di sorpresa, e lui se ne accorge dall'espressione. "Che c'è? Un uomo che lavora con le mani non può gustarsi un drink un po' invecchiato?" Ridacchi, e raccontate entrambi storie dei vostri primi anni. Ti racconta della sua infanzia sul mondo di New Boston, nella Fascia di Terra, e di alcune avventure emozionanti della sua giovinezza fra le stelle, ma di aver trovato la sua passione nell'armeggiare e nel trovare modi per migliorare equipaggiamenti obsoleti.

units.id: conversation:edward epilogue|	You both have a great time hearing of each other's early lives, but you eventually wrap up your visit after a long night of bouncing stories back and forth. You say your goodbyes and head back to your ship.|341|0
units.english: You both have a great time hearing of each other's early lives, but you eventually wrap up your visit after a long night of bouncing stories back and forth. You say your goodbyes and head back to your ship.
units.italian: Passate entrambi un bel po' di tempo ad ascoltare le storie dei primi anni dell'altro, ma alla fine concludete la visita dopo una lunga notte di racconti scambiati avanti e indietro. Vi salutate e torni alla tua nave.
